# Spider Logistics

> Shenzhen Spider Logistics Technology Co., Ltd. is a professional international freight forwarder founded in 2010 and headquartered in Shenzhen, China, with a second office in Guangzhou and a warehouse in Dongguan. The company specializes in air freight, sea freight (FCL and LCL), customs clearance, and door-to-door delivery from China to Bangladesh, Israel, Africa, the Middle East, and worldwide.

Spider Logistics handles China-origin shipments for e-commerce sellers, traders, and manufacturers: air cargo departures from Shanghai, Shenzhen, Guangzhou and Hong Kong; ocean FCL/LCL from major Chinese ports to Chittagong, Haifa, West Africa and East Africa ports; export customs declaration in China; import clearance at destination; and consolidated door-to-door delivery.

## Key facts

- Company: Shenzhen Spider Logistics Technology Co., Ltd. (brand: Spider Logistics)
- Founded: 2010, Shenzhen, China
- Offices: Shenzhen (Baoan District) and Guangzhou (Yuexiu District); warehouse in Dongguan
- Core lanes: China to Bangladesh (air 3-5 days), China to Israel (air 4-6 days), China to Nigeria, Kenya, South Africa, Ghana (sea 25-40 days)
- Services: air freight, sea freight FCL, sea freight LCL, customs clearance, door-to-door delivery, cargo consolidation, warehousing
- Contact: phone +86 13651459671, email yuanvicky6@gmail.com, https://spiderlogisticsinc.cn/contact
- Working hours: Monday to Friday 9:00-18:00 China Standard Time, Saturday 10:00-14:00
